result: Validated the split side of local-certificate aggregation. Exact global test-set fullness/non-fullness bits are aggregated as a canonically colored incidence relation and refined to quotient-point color classes. On wreath-product quotient actions of sizes 8 and 10, uniform strings remained canonically unsplit with every 3-set full, while a distinguished physical block induced a relabeling-invariant singleton structural class and a significant split. The no-split obstruction path remains unresolved and is not counted as solved.

solved_leaf.problem: canonical aggregation of local fullness certificates into a relabeling-invariant significant quotient split when the certificate relation distinguishes points

next_leaf.problem: resolve canonical no-split certificate relations by certifying the global alternating/Johnson-style obstruction or deriving a stronger canonical relational reduction
